title: pilosella longa
intro: Pilosella longa, commonly known as False Sow Thistle or Oxeye Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating symptoms of fever. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella longa include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, tannins, and sesquiterpene lactones. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella longa have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
